text: dsh-crawshrimp-scripts 是 DSH 网页脚本工具插件，通过工具接口列出配置目录中的适配器任务，并按任务标识在浏览器打开网页运行脚本。运行结果包含状态、数据和元信息，并以 JSON 保存到本地工作目录。可配置浏览器、登录状态文件、超时及脚本和输出大小。适合从 DSH 调用便携网页任务；运行前需原生审批。代码未声明 API 密钥。README 标注仓库已停止维护，网页能力迁至后续浏览器插件。

dsh-crawshrimp-scripts adds DSH tools to list adapter tasks and run webpage scripts in a browser. It returns results and saves JSON locally. Browser settings and runtime limits are configurable. Native approval is required. The README marks the repository retired.
想从 DSH 里查找并运行我自己配置的网页自动化任务
能不能把网页脚本的采集结果保存成 JSON 文件？
I want to run a declared browser task from DSH and save its output locally.
dsh-crawshrimp-scripts 的功能「发现网页任务」：调用列表工具后会扫描配置的适配器根目录，返回适配器及其任务清单，也可以按适配器 ID 筛选。
dsh-crawshrimp-scripts 的功能「运行网页任务并保存结果」：运行工具接收适配器 ID、任务 ID 和参数，经原生审批后在浏览器访问任务页面并执行脚本，返回结果并将 JSON 产物写入工作目录。

dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · Crawshrimp Scripts — migrated to Browser：This standalone repository is retired. All webpage work is maintained in [dsh-crawshrimp-browser](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser), including interactive page actions, explicit login state, portable scripts, parameter validation, pagination, live preview and manual takeover.

dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · Crawshrimp Scripts — migrated to Browser：There is no standalone Scripts 0.2.0 release. Browser runs independently and does not depend on this package or the Crawshrimp backend. The original [v0.1.0 source and release](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-scripts/releases/tag/v0.1.0) remain available for history.

dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · Migration：Copy your configured adapter roots, artifact workspace and private login-state path into the Browser row. Keep the old `workspaceDir` explicitly if you want to continue using previous artifacts. Then remove the old plugin and install Browser:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce remove -w dsh-crawshrimp-scripts
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser#v0.2.0
dsh --profile ecommerce --dump-config
```

dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · Migration：Remove any custom `crawshrimp-scripts` row from your profile overlay. Configure the existing/new `crawshrimp-browser` row instead; do not keep both plugins loaded.

dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · Migration：| Old tool/config | Browser equivalent |
| --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_scripts_list` | `crawshrimp_browser_script_list` |
| `crawshrimp_scripts_run` | `crawshrimp_browser_script_run` |
| No offline validator | `crawshrimp_browser_script_validate` |
| `browserChannel` | `channel` |
| `timeoutMs` | `scriptTimeoutMs` |
| `adapterRoots`, `workspaceDir`, `storageStatePath`, `executablePath`, `cdpEndpoint` | Same explicit values |
| Default workspace `~/.dsh-crawshrimp-scripts` | `~/.dsh-crawshrimp-browser`, unless explicitly configured |

dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · Migration：Update saved prompts/workflows to the new tool names. Existing artifacts and private login-state files are not moved or deleted automatically. See the [complete migration guide](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser/blob/v0.2.0/docs/migration-from-scripts.md) for the portable manifest subset and configuration details.

[中文迁移说明](README.zh-CN.md)

dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · Crawshrimp Scripts：已迁入浏览器插件：本独立仓库停止维护。所有网页相关能力统一由 [dsh-crawshrimp-browser](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser) 提供，包括页面操作、登录态、便携脚本、参数校验、翻页、实时预览和人工接管。

不会发布独立的 Scripts 0.2.0。浏览器包可以单独运行，不依赖本包或抓虾后端。原有 [v0.1.0 源码与 Release](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-scripts/releases/tag/v0.1.0) 保留供历史查阅。
section: Crawshrimp Scripts：已迁入浏览器插件

text:
dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · 迁移：先把 adapterRoots、workspaceDir、私有 storageStatePath 和浏览器配置迁入 `crawshrimp-browser` 配置行。如需继续使用旧产物目录，显式保留旧 workspaceDir。然后运行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce remove -w dsh-crawshrimp-scripts
dsh plugin --profile ecommerce add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser#v0.2.0
dsh --profile ecommerce --dump-config
```

删除 profile overlay 中自定义的 `crawshrimp-scripts` 行，保留浏览器包配置，避免同时加载两包。

dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · 迁移：| 原工具/配置 | 浏览器包对应项 |
| --- | --- |
| `crawshrimp_scripts_list` | `crawshrimp_browser_script_list` |
| `crawshrimp_scripts_run` | `crawshrimp_browser_script_run` |
| 原无离线校验 | `crawshrimp_browser_script_validate` |
| `browserChannel` | `channel` |
| `timeoutMs` | `scriptTimeoutMs` |
| adapterRoots、workspaceDir、storageStatePath、executablePath、cdpEndpoint | 复制原显式值 |
| 默认目录 `~/.dsh-crawshrimp-scripts` | `~/.dsh-crawshrimp-browser`，可显式配置旧目录 |
dsh-crawshrimp-scripts README · 迁移：旧产物和登录文件不会自动移动或删除；保存的提示词和工作流需要替换工具名。更多配置与脚本兼容范围见[完整迁移指南](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser/blob/v0.2.0/docs/migration-from-scripts.md)。
